name: Vine Transit: Vine Go Paratransit
description: Paratransit rides near Vine bus routes in Napa County
fullDescription: VineGo is Napa County's ADA paratransit service for people who cannot use regular Vine bus service due to a disability.
whatTheyOffer:
- Curb-to-curb shared ride service
- Service within 3/4 mile of Vine fixed-route bus service in Napa County
- Book up to 7 days in advance; same-day requests welcome if space allows
- Fares from $4 to $8 based on distance; discount passes ($20 for $24 value)
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
howToGetIt:
1. Complete the VineGo paratransit application (available online in several languages)
2. Complete a phone eligibility interview (Eligibility Desk: 707-253-4649)
3. For help with the application, call NVTA at 707-259-8635
4. Once certified, call 707-252-2600 to schedule rides
keywords: Vine Go, Vine Transit, paratransit, ADA, Napa County, disability, wheelchair, door to door
